items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-15
items.q: I'm trying to remember some of the different people I heard you with you know. Since 1949 like Howard, Annie Williams some.

ctx.x: And I don't remember what year I left there and come back over here. But I was there in World War II alone.
